notablePrerequisites: An opponent has a card in exile.
description:
Activate Void Attendant by paying {1}{G} and putting a card an opponent owns from exile into their graveyard, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
When the Eldrazi Scion enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Maskwood Nexus, Lord Skitter's first ability triggers, exiling a card from an opponent's graveyard.
Activate the Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Scion dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
